method.method_draft: Inspect the image and ignore all curved arrows. Count only connections between non-hydrogen atoms: O–C, C–R1, C–R2, C–N, N–N, and the upper N–N connection. Treat any double-bond depiction as one bond connection for the requested total of bonds present. The count is 6.

method.method_draft: Convert the drawing to a heavy-atom adjacency list. The central carbon is bonded to O, R1, R2, and the lower N, giving four heavy-atom edges. The lower N is bonded to the next N, and that N is bonded to the terminal N, adding two more heavy-atom edges. Exclude the two O–H bonds and ignore arrows/charges. Total heavy-atom bond edges = 4 + 2 = 6.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，左侧有带正电的 H2O/O，中心为未标字母的碳原子，碳原子连到 R1、R2、左侧 O 以及右上方的下方 N。右上方还有一个由三个 N 组成的链状片段：下方 N 连接到中间 N，中间 N 连接到末端 N。图中还画有弯箭头和电荷符号。
推理：按指定方法把图转为重原子邻接表，并排除所有涉及氢的键、忽略箭头和电荷。中心碳与 O、R1、R2、下方 N 相连，共 4 条重原子键；下方 N 与中间 N 相连，中间 N 与末端 N 相连，再加 2 条重原子键。因此总重原子键数为 4 + 2 = 6。
